parameters.query:
-- At most one breaker warning per hour.
UPDATE settings SET value = now()::text, updated_at = now()
 WHERE key = 'sla_watch_last_breaker_alert_at'
   AND (value = '' OR value::timestamptz < now() - interval '1 hour')
RETURNING value AS sent_at

-- Overlapping runs cannot escalate the same SLA twice: only rows still unescalated are claimed.
UPDATE assignments SET escalated_at = now()
 WHERE inbox_id = ANY ($1::bigint[]) AND escalated_at IS NULL AND sla_status = 'open'
RETURNING inbox_id

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO sla_watch_runs (mode, due_count, planned, details)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb) RETURNING id

WITH b AS (
  UPDATE assignments SET sla_status = 'breached'
   WHERE inbox_id = ANY ($1::bigint[]) RETURNING inbox_id, deal_id, manager_id
), r AS (  -- failed escalations are released for the next run
  UPDATE assignments SET escalated_at = NULL WHERE inbox_id = ANY ($2::bigint[]) RETURNING inbox_id
)
INSERT INTO lead_events (inbox_id, deal_id, step, detail, execution_id)
SELECT inbox_id, deal_id, 'sla_escalated', jsonb_build_object('manager_id', manager_id, 'notified', 'manager+rop (im) + telegram digest'), $3 FROM b
RETURNING inbox_id

WITH cfg AS (
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'sla_watch_dry_run'), 'true') <> 'false' AS dry_run,
         coalesce((SELECT value::int FROM settings WHERE key = 'sla_escalation_limit'), 10)   AS lim,
         coalesce((SELECT value::int FROM settings WHERE key = 'sla_escalation_breaker'), 50) AS breaker,
         (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'rop_user_id')        AS rop_user_id,
         (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'sla_stage_fail')     AS stage_fail,
         (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'sla_entity_type_id') AS sla_type,
         (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'alert_chat_id')      AS chat_id,
         (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'portal_url')         AS portal_url
), due AS (
  SELECT a.inbox_id, a.deal_id, a.sla_item_id, a.manager_id, a.sla_due,
         round(extract(epoch FROM now() - a.sla_due) / 60)::int AS overdue_min,
         i.payload->'contact'->>'name' AS client
    FROM assignments a JOIN inbox i ON i.id = a.inbox_id
   WHERE a.sla_status = 'open' AND a.sla_due < now() AND a.escalated_at IS NULL AND a.deal_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT row_to_json(cfg) AS cfg,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM due)::int AS due_count,
       (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(d ORDER BY d.sla_due), '[]')
          FROM (SELECT * FROM due ORDER BY sla_due LIMIT (SELECT lim FROM cfg)) d) AS items
  FROM cfg
